units.source_text: 路，是从舞鹤市沿着海湾底部向西，与它津线成直角交叉，不久就越过泷尻岭，出由良川。

en.t: The road runs west from Maizuru City along the innermost part of the bay, crosses the Tazu Line at a right angle, and before long passes over Takijiri Pass and comes out at the Yura River.

units.source_text: 过了大川桥后，沿由良川西岸北上。

en.t: After crossing Okawa Bridge, it heads north along the west bank of the Yura River.

units.source_text: 接着就是历着河流一直导入河口。

en.t: From there it follows the river all the way down to its mouth.
